tip.label: Tip:
tip.1: Only hit a minion when it dies: a last hit pays gold, a normal hit only costs time.
tip.2: Tab shows every player's death timer. Two enemies dead for 30 s is your window for an objective.
tip.3: Click the enemy's Flash in the scoreboard as soon as they use it: the timer tells you when you may be aggressive again.
tip.4: Clicking an objective timer at the top posts the time to your team.
tip.5: Recall right after pushing a wave: it runs into the enemy tower and you lose almost no CS.
tip.6: When an enemy vanishes, their "?" stays on the minimap for 45 s. Ping them missing (V).
tip.7: The River Leviathan stacks: at four stacks the team gets the soul.
tip.8: Kesselbrut stacks add structure damage: the team that has them should push side lanes.
tip.9: Gold efficiency in the shop: above 100 % means the stats are cheaper than the parts.
tip.10: Watch the indicator: if an ability does not stop you while walking, you can dodge during it.
tip.11: After the game the analysis shows what a Challenger would have done in your hardest moments.
tip.12: Left-click an enemy to open its target frame at the top left with health, level and crowd control.

menu.trainerDesc: Last hits, dodging, kiting & combos, duels, teamfight arena, scenarios.
trainer.title: Trainer
trainer.mode.lastHitDesc: One lane, no enemy champion. CS, missed CS, gold per minute, grade at the end. Optional under your own tower.
trainer.mode.dodgeDesc: Skillshots and ground effects aim at you, faster and faster. How long do you last?
trainer.mode.kiteDesc: Dummy stands, walks or chases you. Attack uptime, DPS vs theory, combo time.
trainer.mode.laneDuelDesc: Mid against a bot of your choice: first kill, CS goal or first tower wins.
trainer.mode.jungleDuelDesc: Two junglers, no minions: race for camps and river crabs.
trainer.mode.arenaDesc: Preset level and items, small arena, rounds until someone wins.
trainer.hint.lastHit: Only the last hit counts. Missed = an enemy minion died without your hit.
trainer.hint.dodge: Keep moving: shots aim at you, leading your movement on higher difficulties.
trainer.hint.kite: Move between attacks (attack-move). Every ability in a row = combo, then they are refreshed.
trainer.hint.laneDuel: No jungler, no other lanes. First tower always wins.
trainer.hint.arena: No recall, no respawn until the next round. Time out: more health wins.
trainer.opt.tower: Under your own tower (enemy waves only)

trainer.mode.scenarioDesc: Short scripted situations with a goal and a time limit: tower defence, gank escape, dive, dragon steal, freezing a wave, protecting the carry, Flash dodge.
trainer.hint.scenario: Reach the goal before the time runs out. Retry any time from the result window.
scenario.turret2v1.name: Survive a 2v1 at your tower
scenario.turret2v1.desc: Minute 7, you stand in front of your mid tower at half health. The enemy mid and jungler (one level higher, all-in) arrive with a minion wave.
scenario.turret2v1.goal: Survive 25 seconds – fall back under your tower and use it.
scenario.gankEscape.name: Spot the gank and escape
scenario.gankEscape.desc: Minute 6, you pushed mid far forward. The enemy mid is in front of you, the enemy jungler waits in the river bush next to you.
scenario.gankEscape.goal: Reach your own tower's range alive (25 s).
scenario.towerDive.name: Tower dive for the kill
scenario.towerDive.desc: Minute 9, the enemy mid sits under his tower with 30 % health. You are two levels higher at full health – but the tower shoots you once you attack him.
scenario.towerDive.goal: Get the kill within 20 seconds without dying.
scenario.dragonSteal.name: Steal the dragon with Smite
scenario.dragonSteal.desc: Minute 10, the enemy team is hitting the Leviathan, it is down to half health. You arrive from the river as jungler with Smite.
scenario.dragonSteal.goal: Land the last hit on the Leviathan (Smite once its health drops below Smite damage).
scenario.freezeWave.name: Freeze the wave
scenario.freezeWave.desc: Minute 5, a big enemy wave pushes towards you, your own wave is small. No enemy champion.
scenario.freezeWave.goal: Hold the wave in front of your tower for 60 s (at least 60 % of the time, never at the tower) and get at least 6 CS.
scenario.protectCarry.name: Teamfight: protect the carry
scenario.protectCarry.desc: Minute 12 mid: you play support for your marksman (85 % health). Two all-in enemies dive him.
scenario.protectCarry.goal: Your marksman survives 20 seconds – or both enemies fall.
scenario.flashUlt.name: Flash-dodge an ultimate
scenario.flashUlt.desc: An enemy marksman fires five wide, fast ultimates at you – too wide to walk out of. Flash is back before every shot.
scenario.flashUlt.goal: Dodge at least 4 of 5 shots (Flash sideways out of the path).
scenario.why.trade: Kill secured – but you died too.
scenario.why.lostDragon: The enemy team took the Leviathan.
scenario.why.pushed: The wave did not stay in front of your tower.
ghost.title: What a Challenger would have done
ghost.about: Challenger ghost: a Challenger bot decided along the whole game with exactly your view (same fog, no extra info) without acting. These are the moments where it would have played most differently – with its reason.
ghost.none: No big differences – the Challenger ghost would have decided much like you.
ghost.sub: The {n} most important moments where the Challenger ghost would have decided differently.
ghost.sub1: The moment where the Challenger ghost would have decided most differently.
ghost.retreat.ghost: Would have backed off at once, towards the own tower.
ghost.recall.ghost: Would have backed off and recalled.
ghost.lastHit.ghost: Would have last-hit these {n} minions (≈ {gold} gold).
ghost.objective.ghost: Would have gone to the {obj} to take or defend it.
ghost.allin.situation: Enemy at only {hp} % health in range.
ghost.allin.ghost: Would have gone all-in for the kill.
ghost.out.objLost: Were far away – the enemy took the {obj}.
ghost.out.escaped: Did not follow up, the enemy escaped.
ghost.reason.lowHp: Too little health for this situation.
ghost.reason.towerAggro: The enemy tower was targeting you.
ghost.reason.outnumbered: Outnumbered – more enemies than allies nearby.
ghost.reason.flashSafe: The safe spot was no longer reachable on foot in time.
ghost.reason.wonSkirmish: Fight won – convert the lead into an objective.
ghost.reason.objective: The objective was safe enough (vision, numbers, Smite).
ghost.reason.lastHit: Minion was in the last-hit window.
